note: The canonical T subunit carries no anchor - it assembles with ColQ or PRiMA. P22303-2 is the H subunit, the GPI-anchored form. NetGPI calls the canonical non-anchored at 0.993
Canonical brevican is secreted; Q96GW7-2 is the GPI form. NetGPI calls the canonical non-anchored at 0.994
A selection fault rather than biology: canonical DAF is the anchored form, and APPRIS had picked a transcript encoding the secreted one. NetGPI calls the APPRIS-rung form non-anchored at 0.993

Canonical CD58 is the transmembrane LFA-3. Both anchored candidates predict the same omega site and are identical through it, so the reviewed isoform is named rather than the Ensembl model the ranking preferred

The ladder's transcript (ENST00000449934, 332 aa) diverges mid-TM-helix and retains none of it: identical to the canonical through WQTFHVSAVAA, then out of frame, losing the helix's second half and the KKK cytoplasmic cluster that sets its orientation. DeepTMHMM v1 calls it SP with zero TM; v2's dissent is a 10-aa half-helix. Q29983 is the 383-aa form, helix res 307-328 intact. MICA's shed risk is high, so a secreted form is the worst of the two to build.
Canonical P13591 is NCAM-140, the transmembrane form; P13591-3 is NCAM-120, the GPI form. NetGPI calls the canonical non-anchored at 0.992
Canonical TFPI-alpha is soluble; P10646-2 is TFPI-beta, the GPI form. NetGPI calls the canonical non-anchored at 0.995

GRCh38 carries a frameshifted OR12D1 (protein_coding_LoF, 315 aa). The intact 320-aa protein is UniProt P0DN82, encoded identically by ENST00000703726 on the alternative MHC haplotype scaffold HSCHR6_MHC_DBB
